attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited announced unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. Standalone EBITDA rose to INR 184.55 crore from INR 130.71 crore. Standalone PBT reached INR 178.06 crore, and PAT was INR 132.72 crore. Consolidated PAT stood at INR 133.13 crore. The company transacted goods worth INR 545.80 billion through its e-commerce vertical. MSTC exited its legacy Trading business. Key transactions included selling liquor shop licenses in Karnataka for approximately INR 125 crore, selling land in Hyderabad valued at INR 2863 crore, and selling an Oil Rig for USD 5,808,251.00. The company launched Round 6 of UDAN and Tranche VIII auction of Critical Mineral Blocks. MSTC is examining feasibility for Coal and Mineral exchanges, upgrading its B2C travel portal, and developing a TReDS platform. A conference call with investors is scheduled for 13 November 2026 at 11:00 am IST.

attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. The Board noted Reserve Bank of India granted In-Principle authorisation for setting up and operating Trade Receivables Discounting System under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. Standalone profit for the half year was 13,272.59 Lakhs compared to 9,347.21 Lakhs in the previous year. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was 20,426.35 Lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 1,16,484.63 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The company discontinued procurement business under the BG backed model effective Financial Year 2026-27. Paid up equity share capital remains 7,040.00 Lakhs with a face value of 10 per share.

attchmntText: Mstc Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board noted that the Reserve Bank of India granted In-Principle authorization for setting up and operating a Trade Receivables Discounting System. Standalone profit for the half year was 13,272.59 Lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 20,426.35 Lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents increased to 1,16,484.63 Lakhs. The company discontinued its procurement business under the BG backed model effective the financial year 2026-27. The Board meeting commenced at 15:00 hrs and concluded at 17:30 hrs on 12th November 2026.
